submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires on an adverb, particle or other adverbial post-modifier that FOLLOWS the material it modifies (post-verbal / clause-final: 'money left', 'seen nobody yet', 'done all along', 'sent today', 'used again', 'finished immediately', ', respectively.', 'to the party too', 'on Friday', 'in 2019'), and stays at baseline when the same word instead precedes the verb, auxiliary or adjective it modifies ('today sent to the board' 0.01, 'quickly cancelled' -0.17, 'too big' -0.11). The slot gates but does not determine the response: temporal-deictic and clause-linking adverbs in that slot fire at 0.6-2.2 of the 2.6 maximum (respectively 2.2, today 1.8, again 1.7, too 1.7, thus 1.4, even 1.4, immediately 1.0, yesterday 1.0, already 1.0, therefore 1.0, accordingly 1.1, though 1.1), while verb-level manner, frequency, degree and epistemic adverbs stay under 0.4 there (quickly 0.16, loudly 0.19, often -0.04, always 0.33, extremely -0.12, probably 0.03, perhaps 0.28); its largest secondary contributors are the coordinator ' and' joining two noun phrases (0.4-0.9) and the clitic token '’' (mean 0.65).

rival_explanations: Broader trigger class: every adverb or adverbial in post-verbal/clause-final position fires, whatever the word, so 'quickly', 'loudly', 'often', 'always' and 'extremely' placed clause-finally should reach the same 0.6-2.2 band as 'today' and 'again' (they measured 0.13-0.37).

Narrower trigger class: this is a position-free token detector for a fixed set of frequent adverb/particle tokens ('respectively', 'today', 'again', 'now', 'too', 'even', 'thus'), so pre-verbal 'today' or 'again' should fire as strongly as clause-final ones (they measured 0.01 and -0.04 against 1.77 and 1.73).

Сингле́тный кислоро́д — общее название для двух метастабильных состояний молекулярного кислорода (O2) с более высокой энергией, чем в основном, триплетном состоянии. Энергетическая разница между самой низкой энергией O2 в синглетном состоянии и наименьшей энергией триплетного состояния составляет около 11400 кельвин (Te (a1Δg ← X3Σg−) = 7918,1 см−1), или 0,98 эВ. Открыт Х. Каутским.

Строение молекулы 
Молекулярный кислород отличается от большинства молекул наличием триплетного основного состояния, O2(X3Σg−). Теория молекулярных орбиталей предсказывает три низколежащих возбуждённых синглетных состояния O2(a1Δg), O2(a′1Δ′g) и O2(b1Σg+) (номенклатура объясняется в статье ). Эти электронные состояния отличаются только спином и занятостью вырожденных разрыхляющих πg-орбиталей. Состояния O2(a1Δg) и O2(a′1Δ′g) — вырождены. Состояние O2(b1Σg+) — очень короткоживущее и быстро релаксирующее в более низколежащее возбуждённое состояние O2(a1Δg). Поэтому обычно именно O2(a1Δg) называют синглетным кислородом.

Разница энергий между основным состоянием и синглетным кислородом составляет 94,2 кДж/моль (0,98 эВ на молекулу) и соответствует переходу в близком ИК-диапазоне (около 1270 нм). В изолированной молекуле переход запрещён по правилам отбора: спину, симметрии и по чётности. Поэтому прямое возбуждение кислорода в основном состоянии светом для образования синглетного кислорода крайне маловероятно, хотя и возможно. Как следствие, синглетный кислород в газовой фазе экстремально долгоживущий (период полураспада состояния при нормальных условиях — 72 минуты). Взаимодействия с растворителями, однако, уменьшают время жизни до микросекунд или даже до наносекунд.

Association of BRAFV600E Mutation with the Aggressive Behavior of Papillary Thyroid Microcarcinoma: A Meta-Analysis of 33 Studies

An association between the BRAFV600E mutation and the clinicopathological progression of papillary thyroid microcarcinoma (PTMC) has been suggested. We aimed to summarize the relevant literature and determine the predictive value of BRAFV600E mutation in predicting clinical outcomes and risk stratification in patients with PTMC. A systematic search using PubMed, Cochrane, and Embase up to February 2020 was performed. A total of 33 studies met the inclusion criteria, resulting in a pool of 8838 patients, of whom 5043 (57.1%) patients were positive for BRAFV600E mutation. Tumors with positive BRAFV600E mutation had a higher tendency for multifocality (RR = 1.09, 95%CI = 1.03–1.16), extrathyroidal extension (RR = 1.79, 95%CI = 1.37–2.32), and lymph node metastasis (RR = 1.43, 95%CI = 1.19–1.71). Patients with BRAFV600E mutation were at increased risk of disease recurrence (RR = 1.90, 95%CI = 1.43–2.53). PTMC in patients positive for the BRAFV600E mutation is more aggressive than wild-type BRAF PTMC. Since BRAF-mutated PTMC is generally more resistant to radioiodine treatment, patients with BRAFV600E-mutated PTMC may require earlier management, such as a minimally invasive ablative intervention. Conservative management by active surveillance may be suitable for patients with wild-type BRAFV600E PTMC.


Introduction
Papillary thyroid cancer (PTC) is the most common endocrine malignancy, with detection rates consistently increasing over the past four decades [1]. PTC is generally considered an indolent disease with patients experiencing an acceptable prognosis. Since tumor size is a known risk factor of PTC progression [2], it has been suggested that patients with papillary thyroid microcarcinoma (PTMC), defined as tumors less than or equal to 1.0 cm in diameter, have a better prognosis and may undergo less aggressive treatment. Considering the rather stable incidence-based mortality rates but increased incidence rates of detection, the American Thyroid Association (ATA) supports hemithyroidectomy and active surveillance as potential management options for patients with PTMC [3]. Since early detection and treatment is a long-standing notion in the field of oncology and delayed surgical intervention may increase mortality risk by as much as 94% in thyroid cancer patients [4], it is especially important to determine the tumor molecular characteristics that may predict clinical progression.
The BRAF V600E mutation is caused by substituting valine (V) with glutamic acid (E) at amino acid 600. BRAF mutation is common in patients with PTC, with prevalence rates as high as 51% [5]. BRAF mutation in thyroid cancer occurs only in PTC and PTC-derived anaplastic thyroid cancers, suggesting a role between the two [6]. Siberian tigers. [File photo]
China is planning to let artificially-bred next-generation Siberian tigers to breed in the wild, a leading breeding center for the endangered species announced Tuesday.
A seven-year-old tiger gave birth to a female cub on July 25, 2011, which was the first successful breeding of a Siberian tiger in the wild in China.
"This cub, now one and a half years old, will play the leading role in the wild breeding plan of the next-generation tigers," said Liu Dan, chief engineer of the Heilongjiang Siberian Tiger Garden.
The center is the world's largest breeding facility for Siberian tigers.
The cub is currently more than 70 cm long and 50 kg in weight. Its physical agility and cold resistance ability is superior to its peers due to wild training, Liu said.
The park has found a male Siberian tiger, which is one meter long and 60 kg in weight, that will live with the female tiger in the free-roaming area, Liu said.
Breeding and living in the wild is key for the tigers to go back to the mountains, he said.
The wild breeding of the next-generation Siberian tigers is another attempt to restore the tigers' wild nature and is crucial in protecting the species, he added.
Siberian tigers are one of the world's rarest animal species. Only 300 are believed to be living in the wild, with 20 in northeast China.
The country has been trying to save the species through active breeding programs. The Heilongjiang center has bred more than 1,000 Siberian tigers since its establishment in 1986, when it had just eight of the large cats.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The committee will today review the revised budget for the coming year.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Pre-verbal 'today' between auxiliary and verb is the order the hypothesis measures at 0.01, so the token alone should not fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The engineer again checked every single connection before the inspectors arrived.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Pre-verbal 'again' modifies the following verb, which the hypothesis calls a gated-out position.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The two groups were, respectively, assigned to the treatment and to the control condition.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Parenthetical 'respectively' precedes the participle it modifies, testing whether the slot rather than the token gated the 2.2 peak.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The plan thus failed to attract enough support from the smaller parties.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Sentence-medial 'thus' precedes the verb it modifies, the pre-verbal order the hypothesis calls baseline.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The youngest children in the class understood even the most complicated rule.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'even' is a focus particle attached to the following noun phrase, so it precedes what it modifies.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The old suitcase was too heavy for her to carry up the narrow stairs.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'too' before an adjective is the degree reading the hypothesis measured at -0.11, not the additive final particle.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The forecast for today calls for heavy rain and strong winds across the county.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'today' as a noun governed by 'for' has no verb to post-modify, so the token alone should not activate.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Under pressure from the auditors, the clerk sorted the stack of invoices quickly.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Clause-final manner adverb 'quickly' fills the post-modifier slot but belongs to the verb-level class the hypothesis reports at 0.16.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The choir rehearsed the anthem for an hour and then sang it loudly.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Clause-final 'loudly' is the manner adverb the hypothesis measured at 0.19 in this exact slot.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: He visits his brother at the farm outside town often.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Clause-final 'often' is a frequency adverb, which the hypothesis says stays at baseline even in the firing slot.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: When the storm warning arrived, she quickly cancelled the appointment and drove to the station.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Pre-verbal 'quickly cancelled' reproduces the hypothesis's own counterexample order at -0.17.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The board yesterday approved the merger without asking any questions about the debt.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Pre-verbal 'yesterday' tests whether the reported pre-verbal 'today' (0.01) generalises to another temporal-deictic word.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She left the keys on the counter and took the train.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'left' here is the main verb with a direct object, not a post-nominal modifier of a noun, so the 'money left' peak should not transfer.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The apartment was small yet surprisingly comfortable, and the windows faced the courtyard.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'yet' as a coordinating conjunction between two adjectives neither follows nor modifies a clause, so the part-of-speech change should remove the trigger.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Workers closed the narrow road along the river while engineers inspected the old bridge.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'along' as a preposition preceding its object is the reverse of the clause-final particle in 'done all along'.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The band immediately stopped playing when the hall went dark.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Sentence-medial 'immediately' precedes the verb it modifies instead of ending the clause.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The left side of the painting shows the harbour and the old fort.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'left' as a pre-nominal adjective follows nothing, so it should stay at baseline despite being a claimed trigger token.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Ich glaube, dass der Lehrer heute die Ergebnisse der Prüfung schnell erklärt.
adversarial_test_results.detail: German clause in which 'heute' and 'schnell' both precede the clause-final participle 'erklärt', so a language-general post-modifier account predicts baseline.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Ik denk dat de commissie vandaag het voorstel snel goedkeurt.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Dutch clause in which 'vandaag' and 'snel' both precede the clause-final verb, testing the gate in the language of the ninth top example.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Yesterday the council argued about the budget for the road repairs, the closure of the swimming pool, the proposed new library that residents had requested. Several residents quickly organised a petition, and the chair carefully reminded everyone that the meeting was being recorded. The audience reluctantly stayed calm, the members voted, and the motion passed.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Long passage whose only adverbs are sentence-initial or pre-verbal, with no clause-final modifier, length-matching the long holdout.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Neither party has notified the tribunal of any settlement yet.

readings.explanation: This pole fires on an adverb, particle or other adverbial post-modifier that FOLLOWS the material it modifies (post-verbal / clause-final: 'money left', 'seen nobody yet', 'done all along', 'sent today', 'used again', 'finished immediately', ', respectively.', 'to the party too', 'on Friday', 'in 2019'), and stays at baseline when the same word instead precedes the verb, auxiliary or adjective it modifies ('today sent to the board' 0.01, 'quickly cancelled' -0.17, 'too big' -0.11). The slot gates but does not determine the response: temporal-deictic and clause-linking adverbs in that slot fire at 0.6-2.2 of the 2.6 maximum (respectively 2.2, today 1.8, again 1.7, too 1.7, thus 1.4, even 1.4, immediately 1.0, yesterday 1.0, already 1.0, therefore 1.0, accordingly 1.1, though 1.1), while verb-level manner, frequency, degree and epistemic adverbs stay under 0.4 there (quickly 0.16, loudly 0.19, often -0.04, always 0.33, extremely -0.12, probably 0.03, perhaps 0.28); its largest secondary contributors are the coordinator ' and' joining two noun phrases (0.4-0.9) and the clitic token '’' (mean 0.65).

Broader trigger class: every adverb or adverbial in post-verbal/clause-final position fires, whatever the word, so 'quickly', 'loudly', 'often', 'always' and 'extremely' placed clause-finally should reach the same 0.6-2.2 band as 'today' and 'again' (they measured 0.13-0.37).

Narrower trigger class: this is a position-free token detector for a fixed set of frequent adverb/particle tokens ('respectively', 'today', 'again', 'now', 'too', 'even', 'thus'), so pre-verbal 'today' or 'again' should fire as strongly as clause-final ones (they measured 0.01 and -0.04 against 1.77 and 1.73).
